title: Hedge funds, family offices among those turning to Goldman Sachs ETF Accelerator
description: Goldman's recently created business, which is designed to help firms quickly launch  exchange-traded funds, has more than just traditional asset managers as clients.

title: Why Is NETGEAR Stock Jumping Premarket Thursday?
description: NETGEAR stock is trading higher premarket after the company announced a $135 million settlement agreement with TP-Link, resolving all pending litigation between the parties. The settlement and an earlier-than-expected launch of a new product have led NETGEAR to raise its Q3 2024 revenue and margin guidance.
